image_location_description: Bottom of the image, under both feet

steps.title: Bottom layer plates
steps.description: Place 3x DBG 2x6 plates side-by-side to form a 6x6 base.

steps.title: Center brace
steps.description: Add 1x DBG 1x4 plate across a seam at the center for stiffness.

steps.title: Top layer lock
steps.description: Add 3x DBG 2x6 plates perpendicular to bottom to make 2 plates thick.

steps.title: Front edge tiles
steps.description: Tile the front edge with 3x Black 1x2 tiles; leave center studs open.

steps.title: Back edge tiles
steps.description: Tile the back edge with 3x Black 1x2 tiles; keep middle studs exposed.

steps.title: Corner texture
steps.description: Add 4x DBG 1x1 round plates near the four corners on top.
